limitations: These selected API probes do not replace the complete Wine, 3DMark, MapleStory or shader differential acceptance.
DLLs were rebuilt from unchanged production sources; published binaries are not replaced in this test-only batch.
failuresResolved: Remote smoke initially interpreted heartbeat/capability writes as readback pixels; now selects replies by actual command response address and checks every requested response.

First live XP run used a local-channel DMA view asynchronously, observed zero commands and failed first CopyRects. Enabling remote copy/backpressure fixed it; failed run retained in build/d3d-review/stage4-live-device8-swift.
